from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

from PIL import Image

class Controller:
    def __init__(self,s):
        self.s=s; self.m=s.model
        self.d=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.jids=[self.m.joint('robot0_joint%d'%i).id for i in range(1,8)]
        self.qids=self.m.jnt_qposadr[self.jids]; self.dids=self.m.jnt_dofadr[self.jids]
        self.sid=s.env.robots[0].eef_site_id['right']
        self.a=s.initial_command()
    def pose(self):
        return self.s.data.site_xpos[self.sid].copy(),self.s.data.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3).copy()
    def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
        self.d.qpos[:]=self.s.data.qpos
        if q is not None:self.d.qpos[self.qids]=q
        for _ in range(100):
            mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.d); mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.d)
            ep=np.array(p)-self.d.site_xpos[self.sid]
            er=Rotation.from_matrix(R@self.d.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
            e=np.r_[ep,er*.45]
            if np.linalg.norm(e)<.0003:break
            jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); jr=jp.copy()
            mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,self.d,jp,jr,self.sid)
            J=np.vstack([jp[:,self.dids],.45*jr[:,self.dids]])
            dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*.0001,e)
            dq*=min(1,.15/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-9))
            self.d.qpos[self.qids]=np.clip(self.d.qpos[self.qids]+dq,self.m.jnt_range[self.jids,0]+.01,self.m.jnt_range[self.jids,1]-.01)
        return self.d.qpos[self.qids].copy(),np.linalg.norm(e)
    def move(self,p,R=None,n=60,grip=None):
        p0,R0=self.pose(); R=R0 if R is None else R
        rot=Rotation.from_matrix(R@R0.T).as_rotvec()
        if grip is not None:self.a[7]=grip
        for t in range(1,n+1):
            u=t/n; u=u*u*(3-2*u)
            target=p0+(np.array(p)-p0)*u
            orient=Rotation.from_rotvec(rot*u).as_matrix()@R0
            q,err=self.ik(target,orient,self.a[:7]); self.a[:7]=q
            self.s.step(self.a)
        print('move',len(self.s.actions),'pose',np.round(self.pose()[0],4),'err',round(err,4),flush=True)

        for _ in range(n):self.s.step(self.a)
    def base(self,v,n=30,torso=0):
        self.a[8:11]=v; self.a[11]=torso; self.a[12]=1
        for _ in range(n):self.s.step(self.a)
        self.a[8:12]=0;self.a[12]=-1
